# LCP Directory

> A verified medical-legal directory of board-certified Physician Life Care Planners (MD/DO) specializing in life care planning, future care cost projections, and expert testimony across US states and Canadian provinces.

## What We List
- Board-certified Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (PM&R) physicians
- Certified Life Care Planners (CLCP) and Certified Nurse Life Care Planners (CNLCP)
- State-by-state physician availability across all 50 US states and Canadian provinces

## Who Uses This Directory
- Personal injury attorneys seeking expert witnesses
- Insurance companies requiring objective future care cost assessments
- Families coordinating long-term care
